output.headline: Intermountain Health is a same-sub-sector platform buyer for this target, but it has a single prior deal and no Midwest footprint.
output.differentiator: Intermountain Health's one precedent, a $789M platform investment, is larger than every peer's median deal, so the $200M target is well within its size range. Its record is thinner than the peers'.
output.why_them: Same-sub-sector platform buyer; the Midwest would be new ground

acquirer_overview.title: A 33-hospital system with one acquisition on file
points: Intermountain Health is a Salt Lake City-headquartered strategic with 33 hospitals in Utah, Colorado, Idaho and Montana [P:2].
It merged with SCL Health in 2022, extending into Colorado, Kansas and Montana, and left Kansas in 2024 [P:1, P:2].
One deal on file, in 2022, and it closed. Buyer revenue has not been researched [T:record, K:closed_share, V:synergy].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: A platform buyer already operating in the target's own sub-sector
points: The share of Intermountain Health's deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor in its likelihood [S:sector_share].
Platform Build applies to 1 of 1 of its deals, against 23% of all deals in the file, so it is a distinct motive. Scale and Cross-sell also apply [M:platform_build, M:scale, M:cross_sell].
Margin fit is a modest factor and deal size within its range a slight one. Few deals in recent years count slightly against it [S:margin_fit, S:not_bigger, S:recency].

precedent_activity.title: One precedent: Paramount Care Partners, a $789M platform deal
points: Bought Paramount Care Partners in 2022: a Healthcare Services Platform Investment of $789M at 12.5x EBITDA. It closed [D:MA-2022-0183].
That deal was Multi-Regional. It has no deal in the target's region and none in the $100M-$400M comparable size band [K:by_region, K:size_band].
It has no adjacent provider sub-sector deals. Its only deal was a control purchase [T:record, K:control_share].

valuation_context.title: Defend the 75th percentile; its own 12.5x sits below it
points: Comparable range from 70 deals, 9 of them in the same sub-sector: 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x median, 15.3x at the 75th [V:comps].
The target's 16.8% margin is above the comps' 12.9% median and above 87% of comps, which supports upper-quartile pricing [V:comps].
Its median paid is 12.5x. Cost synergy headroom is $15M-$25M, with half realised; buyer revenue is not researched [V:comps, V:synergy].

risk_flags.title: Thin track record
risk_flags.concern: Only one deal on file and none in adjacent provider sub-sectors, so its appetite is hard to read.
risk_flags.mitigant: That one deal was a same-sub-sector platform investment that closed.
risk_flags.reality: Conviction is Low on this basis, and recent activity counts slightly against it [T:record, S:recency, C:conviction].

risk_flags.title: No Midwest presence
risk_flags.concern: No deal in the target's region, and it left Kansas in 2024.
risk_flags.mitigant: Its 2022 merger shows it will extend into new states.
risk_flags.reality: Its footprint remains Utah, Colorado, Idaho and Montana, so the Midwest would be a new entry [K:by_region, P:1, P:2].

risk_flags.title: Price gap to the upper quartile
risk_flags.concern: The target's case rests on the 75th percentile, and the buyer's own median paid is lower.
risk_flags.mitigant: The 16.8% margin and the $15M-$25M synergy headroom support a higher price.
risk_flags.reality: It paid 12.5x against a 75th percentile of 15.3x, so it may be outbid on price [V:comps, V:synergy].

conviction.rationale: Only 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector, none in adjacent provider sub-sectors and none in the target's region, so the evidence is neutral rather than supportive [C:conviction, T:record].
